name: WooCommerce
description: WooCommerce is an open-source ecommerce platform built as a WordPress plugin, described as "the most flexible ecommerce platform" giving merchants full control over their store.
best_for: Aimed at merchants, developers, and agencies who want full control/customization of their store on WordPress, from small businesses to larger companies needing multichannel selling.
features: Choice of any payment processor, plus native WooPayments
Theme and extension marketplace for customization
Mobile app for managing the store

alternatives.name: Shopify
alternatives.description: A hosted all-in-one commerce platform with built-in payments and multichannel selling.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants who prefer a managed, non-self-hosted solution.

alternatives.name: PrestaShop
alternatives.description: An open-source, self-hostable storefront platform with optional managed hosting.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants wanting open-source ownership outside the WordPress ecosystem.

tiers.name: Core platform
tiers.notes: WooCommerce core is free and open source with no platform fee or revenue share.

tiers.name: Hosting
tiers.notes: WooCommerce says hosting costs $25-$350/month for most stores, scaling with traffic and performance needs.
